boundary: inventory_sources reports transcript metadata/offsets, not ledger reading/support/adoption. Existing validators reconcile declared records, not primary truth or a demonstrated query API.
controls: Query ID/depth: observed row returns report scope/provenance. Metadata-only/BYTE_OFFSET_COVERED never means read/learned. Change one observation: only its derived category changes.
Join source/claim: distinguish supports,contradicts,does_not_support with evidence; dangling claim cannot count. Remove relation: result changes, readability does not.
Supported claim alone gives no adoption. Require declared decision/use status; AUTHORED_NOTE_USE_REPORTED never becomes runtime adoption/evaluation.
Base-only retains historical item15label; explicit r5current projection corrects it, preserving old row/unaffected evidence. Stale pin cannot authenticate current state.
Missing ID,unknown access,uninspected,NOT_ESTABLISHED and NOT_RUN distinct;15aggregate failures give no invented item list. Derive counts from selected records/denominator.
Malformed JSON/schema,duplicate IDs,dangling refs,bad ranges/enums or changed bound inputs refuse, not empty-success. Valid sparse/unknown control remains queryable.
limits: Root verifies. Declared local inputs only; no fetching/transcript expansion,writes,tests or new thresholds.
